fill_front_matter.py.note: PM cold-read 2026-09-27: found and fixed a real regression from the 09-26 colon-field change. The fill loop had switched from text.replace(token, value) to token.sub(value, text); re.sub's repl string treats backslashes as backreferences/\g<name> and raises on a bare backslash before a letter, so any future front-matter.json answer containing a backslash would crash the script or corrupt output. Today's answers happen to be backslash-free so it had not fired live. Fixed with a callable repl (token.sub(lambda _m, v=value: v, text)), which re.sub never post-processes. Proved fail-then-pass against the raw string-repl call and extended ops/tests/test_fill_front_matter_colon_field.py with a permanent case.
